title: Narration audio of a line (assets/narration/<language>/<screen>/<line>.json)
description: What a voice tool or an import wrote next to the audio of one narration line in one language (assets/narration/<language>/<screen>/<line>.m4a): the text it was made from, its length and its voice. Written by tools (elabora narration import, the voice tools), read by the validator (missing or out-of-date audio) and the build. Never shipped in packages.

textHash.description: SHA-256 of the line's text in that language the audio was made from, after Unicode NFC, whitespace runs made one space and trimmed (narrationTextHash in @elabora/core). Another hash: the text changed since, the audio is out of date.

provider.description: The voice tool that made it, or recording for a human voice.

voice.description: The provider's id of the voice (may be empty for a recording).

generated.description: A synthetic voice (AI Act, art. 50): the player and the proof dossier say so.

audioHash.description: SHA-256 of the audio file's bytes when this was written: another file in its place is out of date.

take.description: Which take of a voice that says a line differently each time is in the course (the others stay in the tool's own data, never in assets/).

settingsHash.description: Generated voices: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the settings it was made with (the speaker's voices[language].settings, with the line's delivery[language] over them). Other settings since: out of date.

spokenHash.description: Generated voices: hash of the text the voice was given, after the pronunciations of the line and of the course (spokenText in @elabora/core), normalised as textHash. Another pronunciation since: out of date.

credit.description: What the module's credits say of this voice (the model, the voice and their licences, attribution a CC-BY voice requires). Builds list the distinct credits of a package.

model.description: The model and its revision, for information: another model does not make the audio out of date.

text.description: The line's text in that language when the audio was made (its hash is textHash): once the line is out of date, editors quote the words the voice still says, and word anchors follow the words that stayed.

aligner.description: What timed the words (the forced-alignment model and its revision, or the voice itself), for information.

words.description: When each word of text is said, in seconds from the start of the audio file, in the order of the text (the words of narrationWords in @elabora/core: elisions such as l' and qu' are words of their own): what word anchors resolve to. Written by forced alignment (elabora narration align) when a voice is generated or a recording imported.

score.description: How sure the alignment is that the voice says this word (0 to 1): a word the voice swallowed scores low.
